messages:
Sam: Heads-up — I reproduced a regression on Mixtral-8k with NTK RoPE enabled for >4k sequences. Throughput down ~23% and perplexity spikes on long docs. Repro on dedicated pool A. cc @Maria @Kevin
perf-bot: ci/bench/mixtral-longctx #547: baseline 125.3 t/s, current 95.7 t/s (-23.6%). QA perplexity +0.9 on wiki-long eval.
Maria: Ugh. Do you have a short profiler slice? Kernel selection + KV stats would help.
Sam: Pasted runs below. Command used:
```
rdw-bench --model mixtral-8k --seq 8192 --rope ntk --kernel auto --batch_tokens 20000 --kv-warm 1
```
Profiler snippet (wall ms per token on GPU):
```
kernel: fmha_v1 -> chosen fmha_v2 (auto)
kv_cache_lookup: 0.8 ms
kv_slot_read: 2.1 ms
attention_kernel: 12.3 ms -> 18.7 ms (fmha_v2)
postproc: 1.0 ms
net per-token: 22.9 ms -> 29.5 ms
```
Sam: Also saw more tail latency jitter and an increase in small batches (~<512 tokens) being sent.
Kevin: Interesting. fmha_v2 can be slower on odd head/kv dims combos. What are head dims?
Sam: Mixtral-8k: 64 heads, head_dim=128, kv_dim=64 (head kv dim is half). We recently auto-picked fmha_v2 because sequence > 4k heuristic flipped.
Anuj: That kv_dim mismatch rings a bell. fmha_v2 expects contiguous head kv layout; with head_kv_dim != head_dim/2 we hit suboptimal kernels.
Carla: Could explain perf + perplexity? Why PPL spike?
Kevin: If kernel uses different accumulation / quantization path it can change numerics slightly. But +0.9 PPL on long docs suggests attention gating or prefix eviction ordering changed. Check prefix/KV eviction timing.
Sam: I dumped KV slot churn. Looks like eviction window now 8 tokens earlier under current batching, causing partial cache misses and extra recompute on long sequences.
Maria: So two orthogonal issues: kernel selection causing slower perf, and batching/KV heuristics causing more evictions (hence extra compute + PPL changes).
Maria: Quick mitigation: pin kernel to fmha_v1 for Mixtral-8k in runtime model-profile until we resolve upstream selector logic. Also roll back the aggressive batch_tokens increase for longctx.
Anuj: +1. Also add a guard in kernel selector: require head_kv_dim == head_dim or quantization-friendly layout before choosing fmha_v2 for NTK RoPE.
Kevin: For experiments we should run controlled A/B: NTK vs linear RoPE, fmha_v1 vs fmha_v2, and two batching heuristics (orig batch_tokens=12k vs 20k). Matrix = 2x2x2 = 8 runs. I can script it.
perf-bot: scheduled bench job matrix (8 runs) at 2318765460.
Sam: For immediate triage I ran fmha_v1 pin + batch_tokens=12000 -> throughput 118.9 t/s, perplexity delta back to +0.1. So mitigation works.
Carla: Good. Next: we need a safe per-model RoPE config table so ops don't flip heuristics in prod. Draft proposal:
- Mixtral-8k: NTK allowed but only enabled for seq<=6144; for >6144 use linear fallback or explicit quantized kernel validated.
- Qwen-32k: allow NTK up to 16384, monitor perplexity window.
- Llama variants: keep linear by default (NTK untested).
- Mistral: prefer linear, NTK only w/ head_kv_dim==head_dim.
Maria: Add explicit kernel pinning and verification job to model onboarding flow.
Anuj: Also adjust KV eviction policy: increase warm window to 16 and add a prefix-stability check that prevents eviction if batch tail jitter > X%.
Kevin: I'll add tests to perf CI: longctx-perp/regression checks and a microbenchmark that asserts kernel_time deviation < 10% for model-profile combos.
Sam: Action items:
- Kevin: run the 8-run matrix and upload artifacts (logs + perf traces).
- Anuj: implement kernel-selector guard (head_kv_dim check) and KV eviction warm tweak.
- Maria: update model onboarding checklist with kernel pin tests and safe RoPE ranges.
- Carla: coordinate a canary in dedicated pool after fixes (low traffic).
- Sam: I'll prepare the perplexity eval set (long-docs + synthetic repeats) and rerun with pinned settings.
Carla: Timeline?
Kevin: I'll have matrix results + artifacts by EOD UTC tomorrow.
Anuj: Patch for selector in review, aiming for merge today.
Maria: I'll update docs and ops runbook after selector patch lands.
Sam: Thanks — keeping this thread for follow-ups. If anyone sees related regressions, post perf traces here.
Carla: :thumbsup:
perf-bot: bench artifacts uploaded: /ci/artifacts/mixtral-longctx/2318765472/ (contains perf traces, flamegraphs, kv-churn.csv)
Sam: Saved. Will attach sample trace to the ticket.
